newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 32,000 MT were up 44 percent from the prior week, but down one-fifth from the 4-week average. The primary buyer was Syria (13,500 MT), with smaller quantities to Nicaragua (7,000 MT, of which 6,000 MT was rough), Mexico (3,800 MT, of which 3,700 MT was rough), the Netherlands (2,700 MT), and Haiti (1,500 MT).

Exports of 33,100 MT improved 5 percent from the week earlier, but declined 11 percent from the 4-week average. The major destinations were the Netherlands (14,300 MT), Nicaragua (4,400 MT), Mexico (3,800 MT), South Africa (3,000 MT), Jamaica (2,700 MT), Haiti (1,500 MT), and Belgium (1,300 MT).
